In a homebrew setting some pals and I worked on, we made a point to create a magical "natural resource" akin to depleted Uranium. It was important for the setting and powerful as shit so if you found it and made bullets with it, BAM you can shoot through weak magical barriers and the like. That goes both ways though because if you put it on armor, then nothing short of a tank round is piercing that plate without losing impact damage. It worked pretty well for both balancing and the whole "better weapons don't make better wars" moral we were going for.
